metadata.title: Groupicorn Arkansas IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Local provider groups are considered before named neighboring catchments. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings. Arkansas-local/regional operators are preferred over broad chains when evidence quality is comparable.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url uses a live favicon proxy when an official website is known. This is a prototype discovery placeholder, not a cleared logo asset.
metadata.geocoding_note: ZIP codes and street addresses are stored; coordinates intentionally left null in this pass. Geocode later with a chosen provider.
metadata.generation_note: Generated from source/areas and source/providers by tools/directory.py; edit canonical source files rather than this artifact.
